steps.action: Require explicit founder authorization; verify reviewed inputs and hashes, exact target absent, protected6 unchanged. Reserve entire512MiB plus1GiB floor before first artifact. Capture host architecture/OS without changing settings. Only invoke full absolute interpreter paths; legacy py launcher remains untouched.

Download exact16,619,621-byte NuGet runtime package, require SHA512/base64 match to saved catalogue. Inspect ZIP CRC, actual expanded sizes and path/case/duplicate/reparse/symlink safety before extraction inside target/runtime only. Reject traversal/outside paths or budget overflow. Preserve complete package/notices. No installer/MSIX/NuGet.exe, registry, PATH, launcher, user-site or account mutation. Compare actual member inventory to catalogue; record differences rather than asserting trust. Author/hash/CRC metadata is not cryptographic publisher provenance.

Run target/runtime/tools/python.exe -B explicitly; require exact3.15.0, WindowsAMD64, GIL enabled, expected sys.prefix and bundled pip26.2.1. Record pip/stdlib/native component inventory. Do not bootstrap or upgrade bundled pip. Use process-local PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, remove inherited PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME in child environment; route TEMP/TMP and cache/log/output paths inside target without changing machine environment. Original package managers/environments stay untouched.

On the actual3.15 interpreter, run bundled pip --isolated install --dry-run --ignore-installed --only-binary=:all: --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --report <build-report.json> -r prospective-build-roots.txt. Build roots retain exact current observed pins. This resolves without installing; metadata acquisition can download wheels where metadata is unavailable. Capture all command output and acquired bytes; monitor command-boundary budget and stop on failures.

Inspect every resolved build distribution and extra/marker edge under actual3.15/Windows; require stable versions, no direct/VCS/local unknown dependency, no unresolved requirements and combined package ceiling<=80. Save full report, exact hashed requirements and per-file name/version/tag/Requires-Python/size/hash bindings. Independent read-only review of this concrete resolved graph and execution preparation must PASS before installing build tools. Founder initial permission may cover this bounded result review; no new package count request inside the accepted ceiling, no deployment selection.

Acquire only reviewed hashed binary wheels with --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --no-cache-dir. Check actual ZIP/hash/expanded sizes and reserve retained bytes + twice pending expanded sizes +64MiB overhead <=512MiB, leaving1GiB floor. Create target/build-env via actual3.15 venv --without-pip; use runtime pip --python <build-env Python> to install offline --no-index --find-links wheelhouse --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --no-compile. Record pip check and exact installed identities.

Acquire exactPyYAML6.0.3 sdist by saved SHA256 and byte count; safely inspect tar member paths/types/collisions/expanded sizes and refuse links/devices/traversal. Reserve both separate source extractions/build outputs before writing. Compare3 named build files with captured exact tag bytes, including line endings; stop on any mismatch. Preserve complete sdist and available notices. Do not run setup.py directly or regenerate/download another source revision.

In the private build-env, use pip wheel --no-build-isolation --check-build-dependencies --no-deps --no-index --no-cache-dir --wheel-dir <dist1/dist2> <src1/src2>. Set PYYAML_FORCE_LIBYAML=0 and fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1760000000 in each command process only. Retain declared setuptools/Cython build requirements even with the extension disabled; record dynamic build requirements and stop if new ones appear. No network or C compiler/LibYAML installation. Build twice from distinct clean extracted sources; no automatic repair/retry.

Inspect two new wheel archives without import: identity/version, Root-Is-Purelib, tags, file hashes/RECORD, expanded sizes, notices and absence of native extension/binary members. Require normal py3/none/any eligibility for actual3.15 and consistent metadata. Compare full wheel SHA256; if different preserve detailed ZIP member difference and stop without claiming reproducibility or accepting a normalized comparison. Setuptools/Cython versions or build flags cannot silently change to make it pass.

Run actual3.15 bundled pip --isolated install --dry-run --ignore-installed --only-binary=:all: --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --find-links <verified local PyYAML wheel directory> --report <full-report.json> -r prospective-roots.txt. Keep all14 family roots/extras and dated current root pins; allow pip to choose mutually constrained stable transitives rather than independently pinning their newest versions. Require chosen PyYAML is exact reviewed local wheel/hash and inspect every marker/extra edge including Windows-specific dependencies. The14 individually-current observations are not a selected compatible set.

Freeze full resolved graph, actualPyYAML build evidence, exact hashed wheel bindings, role closure and probe/runner sources. Independently review before full-environment installation. Require all applicable package counts/budgets/stable checks and original18 probe hashes; no expected behavior changes to force a pass. A conflicting graph is retained as concrete evidence; do not remove extras, back off root/runtime pins or add prereleases without the appropriate reviewed exception/decision.

Acquire only remaining reviewed exact hashed wheels using --no-deps --require-hashes; preserve PyYAML own-built wheel. Check ZIP/hash/expanded-size reservation before creating target/qualification-env via3.15 venv --without-pip. Install with runtime pip --python <qualification-env Python> --no-index --find-links <reviewed wheelhouse> --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --no-cache-dir --no-compile. Run pip check and compare every normalized installed identity/hash to the frozen candidate.

Run unchanged original18 cases plus6 prospective PyYAML/Uvicorn cases under actual3.15 qualification-env. Initialize Authlib deprecation module before error filters; preserve current Starlette/Authlib error filters, disable pytest auto-plugins/bytecode/cache and load only pytest_asyncio. Save warning-filter admission, JUnit and raw stdout/stderr; any skipped/error/failed case prevents qualification. YAML malformed/unsafe-tag rejection is synthetic library behavior only. No Hengshi app import, real credential/token, network, server/listener/database or provider call.

Save runtime package/bundled pip component inventory, build/qualification installed graph and all discovered wheel/source/runtime notices; distinguish discovered files from complete embedded licensing/provenance. Recheck all6 protected hashes and measured retained/free bytes after every stage, including failures. Independent bounded result review before any later adoption proposal. No application, production runtime/lock or licence/security clearance follows from24 synthetic library cases.

Stop on unknown/missing ownership, mismatch, over-budget, timed-out command, new build dependency or source/graph/test drift. Wait or terminate only the recorded owned process tree under the approved execution controller; never restart from a mere observation timeout. Preserve terminal failures and outputs. Rollback is retaining the original untouched application/runtimes/trials and not invoking the research paths. No automatic deletion; removing output later requires its own explicit approval.
